spanish: Y todo el niño en las mujeres que no conocieron yacer de macho, hagan vivir a ustedes.

findings.issue: «hagan vivir a ustedes» makes the addressees the patient of the hiphil. The child is the one caused to live; לָכֶם is only the beneficiary.

notes: Remaining words match the tokens, including 2mp hagan for the imperative.
